picks.question: Will the unemployment rate (U-3) be above 4.1% in October?
picks.why: Unemployment above 4.1% would signal a cooling labor market, shaping Fed decisions and wage growth heading into 2027.

picks.question: Will inflation reach more than 4.5% in 2026?
picks.why: Inflation above 4.5% would erode real incomes and push the Fed toward tighter policy, reversing recent disinflation progress.

picks.question: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by December 31?
picks.why: About a fifth of global oil moves through Hormuz, so prolonged disruption keeps energy prices and inflation risks elevated worldwide.

picks.question: Billionaire one-time wealth tax passes in California election 2026?
picks.why: A state-level wealth tax would test whether taxing large fortunes raises revenue or drives capital and residents elsewhere.

picks.question: Will Anthropic have the best AI model at the end of December 2026?
picks.why: Leadership in frontier AI models shifts investment, talent and pricing power across a sector driving much of today's capital spending.

picks.question: Will OpenAI announce another Millennium Prize solution by December 31, 2027?
picks.why: An AI-produced solution to a famous open math problem would mark a leap in machine reasoning with broad research implications.
